title: Projects
text:
Evolutionary algorithm demo. A population of 100 neural-network-controlled spaceships learn to dodge asteroids over successive generations. The green player is the best individual copied from the previous generation, while the rest are selected through fitness-proportional roulette-wheel selection and mutated to explore new movement strategies.
